description: This Java class 'ApiRequestParameterHelper' processes query parameters from API requests to determine settings such as response fields, template usage, maker-checker permissions, and JSON inclusion. It helps configure serialization settings based on request parameters.

classes.name: ApiRequestParameterHelper
classes.description: A helper component used to process API request query parameters and generate serialization settings, including response fields, templates, maker-checker properties, and JSON inclusion.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes query parameters alongside a set of mandatory response parameters to generate serialization settings, including response fields, templates, maker-checker, and JSON inclusion flags.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Overloaded method that processes query parameters only, without additional mandatory response parameters, to produce serialization settings.
